title: Black Friday Video Ads From One Photo | AIVideosUGC
description: Build a Black Friday video ad from one product photo, then add the confirmed offer after download. Choose a setup for social posts and product pages.
h1: Black Friday Video Ads You Can Post Before the Rush
lead: Place your product photo in a setup, and add a spoken AI voice if you want one. Put the price, code, and end date on after you download.

steps.d: Upload one sharp photo of the product in the offer. Keep the full shape and finish visible.
Describe the setting, pick a spoken AI voice, and choose 6 to 30 seconds. Leave the exact price out of the video.
Download the clip, add captions if needed, and type the confirmed price, code, or end date.

faq.q: What does this Black Friday template make?
faq.a: A deal clip from your product photo, with an AI actor, a script, and a spoken voice if you want them. You still type the confirmed price, code, and end date after download.

faq.q: How does the scene come together?
faq.a: Upload one product photo, describe the setting, pick a size and a length, then add captions or the offer in the editor on this site.

faq.q: Why not book a shoot for the sale?
faq.a: The background is built from the photo you have, so you can skip a studio camera and a big setup before sale week.
Shops that need a product clip for Black Friday, Cyber Monday, or a later holiday offer, on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, or a product page.

faq.q: Can I do this without editing experience?
faq.a: Yes. The setup is built for you. Add stickers, captions, a song from the music library, or an AI voice in the editor on this site. Put the offer on only after you confirm it.
One sharp photo of the item that is actually in the offer, with the full shape and finish visible. A short clip you have rights to can be uploaded too.

faq.q: Which size and length fit a deal post?
faq.a: Use a tall 9:16 for Stories and Reels, or a square 1:1 for the feed. A wide 16:9, a slightly wide 4:3, and a slightly tall 3:4 are there when the post needs that shape. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Publish to TikTok, Facebook, or Instagram from the same project.

faq.q: Does the generator write the discount?
faq.a: No. Add the live price, code, and end date after download. If the offer changes, edit that text instead of trusting an old file.

Credits are what each video spends. 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. You see the cost first. If it fails, those credits come back. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits, Pro is $35 with 300, and Premium is $63 with 600.

faq.q: Can I use the download in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. It has no watermark, which means no logo is stamped on the file. If a person appears, that person is an AI actor, not a shopper who bought the deal.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link, many products at once, or my own software?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a product page link for a script and a voice copied from one you may use. When many products share the sale setup, run them at once (a batch), or start jobs from your own software (the API). Another language can reuse the same photo. You still confirm the offer text.
